subject: Japan
note: Hand-curated from the pinned World Bank series (public/geo/series.json): life expectancy at birth (SP.DYN.LE00.IN). Counts are over the countries and territories the table has a figure for in that year (213 in 1960, 214 in 1980, 215 in 2000 and 2022).

claims.text: In the World Bank's life-expectancy table, 20 of the 213 countries and territories with a 1960 figure had a life expectancy of 70 years or more.
In 1960, 76 of those 213 had a life expectancy under 50 years.
By 1980, 59 of the 214 with a figure had a life expectancy of 70 years or more.
By 2022, 150 of the 215 with a figure had a life expectancy of 70 years or more.
Japan's life expectancy at birth rose from 67.7 years (about 68) in 1960 to 84.0 years (about 84) in 2022.
